beforeBuildCommand.script: npm run build --prefix controller && npm run build --prefix presentation && node scripts/merge-presentation-dist.cjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: sdmedia: http://sdmedia.localhost; media-src 'self' sdmedia: http://sdmedia.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Presentation control: import PPTX/PDF, projector output, notes and timer
bundle.longDescription: Imports PowerPoint and PDF decks, shows them on a projector display, and gives the operator a controller with notes, timer and scene media.
